column1: # Every public file the corpus jobs fetch, pinned by origin, commit and sha256
# (#95, #96). tools/corpus/fetch.py downloads them for the run; none is ever
# committed to this repository. Each source's provenance is in CLEANROOM.md
#   source   directory under the fetch destination (nextgis, acadsharp)
#   repo     GitHub repository the file is fetched from
#   commit   the commit it is pinned to
#   licence  as the repository states it ("none stated": fetched, never shared)
#   app      authoring application and build, from the source's own record
#            and each R2004+ drawing's AcDb:AppInfo ProductInformation
#   release  AC magic of a DWG; $ACADVER of a DXF
#   sha256   exact hash; a mismatch fails the job
#   blob     git object id of the file at that commit (the git blobs API route)
#   twin     for a DWG, AutoCAD's DXF export of the same drawing, or -
#   tests    yes for the 19 files tests/samples.rs and its siblings are pinned
